faqs.question: What is included when I purchase a website source code package?
faqs.answer: You receive the complete, unminified source code repository (ZIP package) containing all frontend and backend components, TypeScript interfaces, Tailwind styling, clean project documentation, and step-by-step local setup and cloud deployment instructions.

faqs.question: Can I view a live demo before purchasing?
faqs.answer: Yes! Every website listing includes an interactive live demo preview with responsive device switching (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile) right here on Smart Developer, as well as a full-screen preview option.

faqs.question: Do you provide customization services if I need custom features?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You can request custom modifications, logo and branding changes, payment gateway integrations (Stripe, PayPal, local bank channels), or full custom web application development through our Custom Development form.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept for international clients?
faqs.answer: We cater to clients in Pakistan, the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and worldwide. We accept direct Bank Wire Transfers, Wise, Payoneer, Crypto (USDT), and official Card/Stripe invoices.

faqs.question: How fast do I receive the website code after submitting a purchase request?
faqs.answer: Once your purchase request is verified by our team (usually within 1 to 4 hours), your digital package download link and setup documentation are delivered directly to your verified email.

faqs.question: Do you help with hosting, domain connection, and launch?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide deployment guides for leading cloud providers (Vercel, Cloud Run, Netlify, AWS, VPS). You can also select our Full Deployment add-on service to have us handle domain DNS and production launch for you.

faqs.question: What kind of support is included?
faqs.answer: Every purchase includes 30 days of direct developer email support for setup assistance, bug fixes, and general questions regarding the codebase.
